title: Announce errors and dynamic workflow status
description: Associate validation errors with affected controls and conservatively announce compatibility, calibration, autosave, storage, import, and generation outcomes while keeping messages available for review.
acceptanceCriteria: Field errors are programmatically associated with invalid controls and summarized with focusable links when submission fails
Compatibility, calibration, autosave, storage, import, and generation outcomes use appropriate polite or assertive status semantics
Each meaningful outcome is announced once with enough context to identify the affected work
Messages remain visibly available for review and do not expose unrelated private content

steps.details: Map field errors, blocking refusals, progress, saves, and completion outcomes to inline association, status, alert, or no-announcement behavior.
Create restrained error-summary and live-status components with stable IDs, deduplication, and affected-work context.
Render existing domain reason codes and operation outcomes through associated fields and persistent status surfaces.
Test aria-describedby/invalid links, summary navigation, live-region role/content changes, deduplication, and visible message persistence.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; cover one shared status layer and representative outcome fixtures.
Avoid nested live regions and repeated announcements caused by rerenders.
